description: Use this when a seller wants supplier pricing for a specific print-on-demand product size or color, such as an adult M black T-shirt or an 11 oz mug. Lists the product's fields and supported configurations for the destination and currency; narrow with words or choices. Pass a returned key as optionKey, or its choices, to compare_product. Search products first to obtain canonicalProductId. Supported destinations: US, GB, DE, AU, CA.

canonicalProductId.description: A product id from search_products or resolve_supplier_link, such as `cotton-ringer-tee`.

choices.description: Choices by field, such as { "size": "m", "color": "black" }. Values match a value key, its last part or its label, case-insensitively; get_product_options lists them.

currency.description: Currency for every price, such as USD, GBP or EUR.

destination.description: The buyer's country, where the order ships. Product cost, shipping and duty depend on it.

offset.description: How many results to skip. Pass nextOffset from the previous page.

query.description: Words to narrow the list, such as `m black`.

name: get_product_options

defaultOptionKey.description: The configuration compare_product uses when none is given; null when the product has none.

fields.description: The choice fields this product has and their available values.

field.description: The field name to use in `choices`, such as size or color.

label.description: The field as a person would say it, such as Size.

values.description: The values this field has among the matching configurations.

label.description: That value as the supplier names it.

value.description: The value to pass back in `choices`.

nextOffset.description: Offset to pass for the next page; null on the last page.

choices.description: The same choice by field, ready for compare_product `choices`.

key.description: The configuration's key, to pass as optionKey.

label.description: The configuration in words, such as `Adult M / Black`.

supplierCount.description: How many suppliers price this configuration.

totalCount.description: How many configurations match in total, across every page.

error.description: The error this call returned instead of a result.

code.description: The machine-readable reason the call failed.

message.description: What went wrong, in words, and what to do next.

title: Find product configurations
